title: myoporum acuminatum f. ellipticum
intro: Myoporum acuminatum f. ellipticum, commonly known as the sweet ground berry or sweet myoporum, is a species of flowering plant in the family Scrophulariaceae. The plant has been found to have several health benefits, including its potential to act as an antioxidant and anti-inflammatory agent, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. Its therapeutic actions include being used to treat various health conditions such as gastrointestinal issues and skin problems due to its antimicrobial and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are also found in other plants used in traditional medicine.
